message.content:
Green age began in the year of the silver rain, when the river kings bound the first waterwheels, and the world turned slowly around lantern-light, Green
Silent years followed the first turning of the moon, with no factory whistle splitting the air, and the cities bloomed like gardens beneath the patient sky, Silent
Star roads wove through the night in the third season of the long peace, as caravans of glowing paper-ferries crossed valleys filled with singing mist, Star
Living towers rose in the age of the braided forest, their libraries breathing with the trees and their bells ringing only for rain and harvest, Living
Gentle markets traded in honey, rainwater, and woven starlight while the people measured the centuries by the turning seasons and the flight of birds, Gentle
Quiet futures unfolded after the last ember of ambition cooled, and the horizon stayed soft with the dream of a world that never learned to burn, Quiet
